key_insight: Generative design and consensus GNN screening identified four DFT-validated bimetallic HER candidates with near-thermoneutral hydrogen binding: Pd5Au, Pt5Rh, Cu5Pt3, and Pd13Ru3.
engineering_relevance: The pipeline narrows catalyst candidates for experimental follow-up while exploring alloy structures and stoichiometries beyond the training database.
method: Fine-tune MatterGen on adsorption-labelled bulk alloys to generate novel bimetallic structures targeting near-zero hydrogen adsorption energy.
Use MatterSim to rank low-index facets and relax hydrogen-covered slabs at high-symmetry adsorption sites.
Combine MEGNet–ALIGNN consensus with MatterSim energy-difference checks, then validate shortlisted alloys using DFT and phonons.
evidence_signal: Of eight alloys evaluated by plane-wave DFT, four bound hydrogen within the thermoneutral window; phonon calculations indicated all eight were dynamically stable.
watch_item: Near-thermoneutral binding is not experimental proof of HER performance, and all four highlighted candidates contain precious metals.
paper_title: Generative Design and Graph Neural Network Screening of Novel Bimetallic Alloy Catalysts for the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction
